scope: Single-clock edge-sampled equality; no retiming or latency changes; no asynchronous reset
parameter_scope: Only this fixed parameter instance; no proof for other values
initial_state: Independent arbitrary defined states; all DUT init attributes removed before proof and synthesis
initialization_scope: Full outputs after one sampled synchronous reset; no RTL initialization assumption or no-reset power-up guarantee
state_relation_scope: Additional compared outputs with complete SAT base and induction; no state equality assumption or cutpoints
reset_contract: Reset asserted at samples 1..1; unconstrained afterwards
proof: Full base case plus temporal induction; strict equality after warmup; all defined inputs
mapping: dffunmap -ce-only; dfflibmap; ABC map, cleanup, buffer, upsize, dnsize
